raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
# Description

Fixes #3711.

flash-attn's head_dim 256 backward (`run_mha_bwd_hdim256`) picks its kernel by opt-in shared memory per block. Below 144 KB it launches no kernel at all when dropout is enabled, and returns without an error, so `dq`/`dk`/`dv` are never written. sm86, sm89, sm120 and sm121 all have 99 KB. Padded head dims 224 and 256 both use this kernel. The flash-attn side is Dao-AILab/flash-attention#3053; the check that used to reject this case was removed in Dao-AILab/flash-attention@bbb21d6.

TE's FA2 head_dim > 192 allowlist includes `(12, 0)`. Training with dropout at a padded head dim in (192, 256] on sm120 therefore selects FA2 and gets unwritten gradients. With flash-attn 2.8.3, a backward with `dq`/`dk`/`dv` pre-filled with NaN leaves them 100% NaN:
- on an RTX 5090 (sm_120, 101376 B opt-in shared memory per block), for head_dim 224 and 256 with `dropout_p=0.1`;
- not without dropout, and not at head_dim ≤ 192;
- not on B200 (232448 B), where every case computes.

This PR disables FA2 in exactly that case:
- padded head dim > 192;
- `attention_dropout > 0`;
- training mode;
- backward required;
- one of the 99 KB GPUs, `(8, 6), (8, 9), (12, 0), (12, 1)`.

Inference, dropout-free training and forward-only calls keep FA2. sm86/sm89/sm121 are already excluded by the allowlist for head_dim > 192. Listing them keeps the gate correct if that list is relaxed later.

## Type of change

- [ ] Documentation change (change only to the documentation, either a fix or a new content)
- [x] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Infra/Build change
- [ ] Code refactoring

## Changes

- `get_attention_backend`: a separate check right after the existing FA2 head-dim check. It turns FA2 off for the case above and logs the reason at debug level.
- `test_fa2_large_head_dim_dropout_backend_selection` in `tests/pytorch/attention/test_attention_backend_selection.py`, which mocks the compute capability:
  - sm120 with dropout at padded head dim 256, 224, and MLA 192/256: FA2 is not selected;
  - controls where FA2 stays selected: sm120 without dropout, in eval, forward only, and at head dim 192; sm100 with dropout.

## Testing

- New test against unpatched `utils.py`: the three sm120 dropout cases fail; the 5 controls pass.
- New test with the patch: 8/8 pass. Whole `test_attention_backend_selection.py`: 36 passed, 2 skipped (the existing SM12x-GPU tests).
- Together with #3714 (sm103 allowlist), the whole file gives 43 passed, 2 skipped. The two changes touch separate hunks.
- How the tests ran: these tests need no GPU, so they ran in a process with no visible GPU. That process used a source build of TE at `9d9bd9e5` with this branch's Python sources on top. The attention selector and its tests are unchanged between `9d9bd9e5` and this branch's base `a7b6c0cb`.
- `black` 24.4.2 with the repository's pre-commit arguments reports no changes.
- The hardware numbers above are from flash-attn directly; see Dao-AILab/flash-attention#3053 for the reproducer. I have not run TE end to end on sm120.

# Checklist:

- [x] I have read and followed the [contributing guidelines](https://github.com/NVIDIA/TransformerEngine/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.rst)
- [x] The functionality is complete
- [x] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas
- [x] I have made corresponding changes to the documentation
- [x] My changes generate no new warnings
- [x] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works
- [x] New and existing unit tests pass locally with my changes

 def test_fa4_window_sentinel_normalization(sent, expected):
     """Convert only TE's -1 sentinel for both FA4 window argument forms."""
     assert _fa4_normalized_kwargs(sent) == expected
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "capability,head_dims,dropout,is_training,requires_backward,expect_flash",
+    [
+        pytest.param((12, 0), (256, 256), 0.1, True, True, False, id="sm120-d256-dropout"),
+        pytest.param((12, 0), (224, 224), 0.1, True, True, False, id="sm120-d224-dropout"),
+        pytest.param((12, 0), (192, 256), 0.1, True, True, False, id="sm120-mla-d256-dropout"),
+        pytest.param((12, 0), (256, 256), 0.0, True, True, True, id="sm120-d256-no-dropout"),
+        pytest.param((12, 0), (256, 256), 0.1, False, True, True, id="sm120-d256-eval"),
+        pytest.param((12, 0), (256, 256), 0.1, True, False, True, id="sm120-d256-forward-only"),
+        pytest.param((12, 0), (192, 192), 0.1, True, True, True, id="sm120-d192-dropout"),
+        pytest.param((10, 0), (256, 256), 0.1, True, True, True, id="sm100-d256-dropout"),
+    ],
+)
+def test_fa2_large_head_dim_dropout_backend_selection(
+    monkeypatch, capability, head_dims, dropout, is_training, requires_backward, expect_flash
+):
+    """FA2 is not selected where its head_dim 256 dropout backward has no kernel (< 144 KB smem)."""
+    monkeypatch.setenv("NVTE_FLASH_ATTN_V2", "1")
+    monkeypatch.setenv("NVTE_FLASH_ATTN_V4", "0")
+    monkeypatch.setattr(dpa_utils, "get_device_compute_capability", lambda device: capability)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(dpa_utils, "get_cudnn_version", lambda: (9, 26, 0))
+    fa2_version = PkgVersion("2.8.3")
+    monkeypatch.setattr(dpa_utils.FlashAttentionUtils, "is_installed", True)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(dpa_utils.FlashAttentionUtils, "version", fa2_version)
+    for flag in (
+        "v2_plus",
+        "v2_1_plus",
+        "v2_3_plus",
+        "v2_4_plus",
+        "v2_4_1_plus",
+        "v2_5_plus",
+        "v2_5_7_plus",
+        "v2_6_0_plus",
+        "v2_7_0_plus",
+    ):
+        monkeypatch.setattr(dpa_utils.FlashAttentionUtils, flag, True)
+    params = dpa_utils.AttentionParams(
+        device=torch.device("cuda:0"),
+        qkv_dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+        qkv_layout="bshd_bshd_bshd",
+        head_dim_qk=head_dims[0],
+        head_dim_v=head_dims[1],
+        attn_mask_type="causal",
+        attention_dropout=dropout,
+        is_training=is_training,
+        requires_backward=requires_backward,
+    )
+    flash, selected_version, _, _, _, available = dpa_utils.get_attention_backend(params)
+    assert bool(flash) is expect_flash
+    assert selected_version == (fa2_version if expect_flash else None)
+    assert bool(available[0]) is expect_flash
